tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh new production-quality transparent RGBA illustration: ONE full-body single pose of the exact Steller Sea Lion adopted in image1. Image1 is identity/style/proportion reference only, not an edit target. Highest native resolution available. Preserve precisely its head-to-torso ratio, torso length/thickness, face, eye format, palette, warm brown line character, gentle clean watercolor paper texture, distinctive markings, horns/ears/bill/tail and original limb count. Generous transparent margins around each complete subject. No text, labels, border, grid lines, floor, shadows, background, props, clothing, effects, sparkles or extra animals. Keep the simplified nonhumanoid animal prop; no human hands/arms/legs/eyebrows/lips or new large eyes. All subjects use the SAME head/body size and body reference; only the specified gesture changes. Do not fit or enlarge bent poses. 1 SPECIES_A: A gentle small lift of one reference-visible foreflipper, keeping the same resting body projection and support. Species constraints: 前びれを人の手へ変えない。後端を新しい足・尾として二重に描かず、既存の支点種別に従う。 Finish with clear clean face/contours and connected complete appendages, without smudges, patchy pigment blobs, doubled parts, jagged alpha halos or clipping. Open eyes preserve reference design with no new glints. Every single part stays visible within its own transparent area. This replaces only the listed failing pose(s); preserve the reference identity and do not create other states. CRITICAL ANATOMY: The animal has exactly TWO front flippers in total plus the paired rear flippers at the back. If far front flipper is raised, remove its old resting position: there is NO third front flipper under the chest on the far side. Near foreflipper remains the one large resting triangular limb. Rear flipper pair stays separate behind the body. Do not turn this into a human wave. Head/bill direction for PRESENT_RIGHT must face viewer right naturally.
